DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-ZENTSUJI-02-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-ZENTSUJI-02-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 展示についてお尋ねがあればどうぞ。この棚の品には、それぞれ説明札が付いています。
DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-ZENTSUJI-02-001-SHARED-01.translation: Please ask if you have any questions about the exhibits. Each item on this shelf has its own explanatory label.

DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-ZENTSUJI-02-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-ZENTSUJI-02-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 学校の発表で使うメモを書いています。この土器は、昔の人が実際に使った物でしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-ZENTSUJI-02-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 学校発表のメモのため、土器が当時使われた実物か尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-ZENTSUJI-02-001-SHARED-02.translation: I am making notes for a school presentation. Is this pottery an actual item that people used in the past?
DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-ZENTSUJI-02-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask in Japanese whether the pottery is an original used at the time, for your school-presentation notes.

DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-ZENTSUJI-02-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-ZENTSUJI-02-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: その品は復元模型です。発掘された破片を手がかりに、形を再現したものと説明札にあります。
DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-ZENTSUJI-02-001-SHARED-03.translation: That item is a reconstructed model. The label says its shape was recreated using excavated fragments as clues.

DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-ZENTSUJI-02-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-ZENTSUJI-02-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 本物だと思って書いてしまいました。実物の破片は、どちらに展示されていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-ZENTSUJI-02-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 本物だと思ったと認め、元の破片の展示場所を聞く。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-ZENTSUJI-02-001-SHARED-04.translation: I wrote that it was genuine because I thought it was. Where are the original fragments displayed?
DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-ZENTSUJI-02-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Acknowledge in Japanese that you thought it was genuine, and ask where the original fragments are displayed.

DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-ZENTSUJI-02-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-ZENTSUJI-02-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 隣の低いケースです。全部の破片がそろっていたわけではないため、模型の一部は推定を含むと解説されています。
DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-ZENTSUJI-02-001-SHARED-05.translation: They are in the low case beside it. The explanation says some of the model is conjectural because not all the fragments were present.

DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-ZENTSUJI-02-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-ZENTSUJI-02-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: それなら、『分かった形』と『推定した形』を分けて発表したいです。説明札のどこを読めば区別できますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-ZENTSUJI-02-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 確認できた形と推定した形を分けて発表するため説明箇所を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-ZENTSUJI-02-001-SHARED-06.translation: Then I would like to distinguish the confirmed shape from the inferred shape in my presentation. Which part of the label should I read to tell them apart?
DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-ZENTSUJI-02-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Ask in Japanese which explanation distinguishes the confirmed and inferred shapes so you can present them separately.

DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-ZENTSUJI-02-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-ZENTSUJI-02-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 下段の図に、残っていた部分と復元した部分が色分けされています。まず凡例を見てから図を読むと分かりやすいですよ。
DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-ZENTSUJI-02-001-SHARED-07.translation: The diagram below uses different colors for the surviving and reconstructed parts. It is easier to understand if you look at the key before reading the diagram.

DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-ZENTSUJI-02-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-ZENTSUJI-02-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 図を見ながらメモします。あとで確認するため、説明札を写真に撮ってもかまいませんか。
DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-ZENTSUJI-02-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 図をメモすると述べ、後で参照するための説明札撮影を相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-ZENTSUJI-02-001-SHARED-08.translation: I will take notes while looking at the diagram. May I photograph the explanatory label to refer to later?
DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-ZENTSUJI-02-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you will note the diagram, and ask about photographing the label for later reference.

DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-ZENTSUJI-02-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-ZENTSUJI-02-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: このケースの表示では撮影できますが、フラッシュは使わないでください。別の展示は、その場所の撮影表示を確認してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-ZENTSUJI-02-001-SHARED-09.translation: The sign for this case allows photography, but please do not use flash. For other exhibits, check the photography signs at each location.

DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-ZENTSUJI-02-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-ZENTSUJI-02-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: ここではフラッシュを切ります。発表には復元模型と明記して、実物の破片と混同しないようにします。
DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-ZENTSUJI-02-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: フラッシュを切り、復元模型であると明記して実物と区別すると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-ZENTSUJI-02-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will turn off the flash here. In my presentation, I will clearly identify it as a reconstructed model so it is not confused with the original fragments.
DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-ZENTSUJI-02-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you will turn off the flash, label it as a reconstructed model, and distinguish it from the originals.

DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-ZENTSUJI-02-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-ZENTSUJI-02-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: それなら見たことが正確に伝わりますね。メモができたら次の展示もどうぞ。見学をお楽しみください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-ZENTSUJI-02-001-SHARED-11.translation: That will communicate what you saw accurately. Once you have your notes, please look at the next exhibit too. Enjoy your visit.

DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-ZENTSUJI-03-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-ZENTSUJI-03-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 今日は畦を回って、水の様子を見てください。水門の操作は私が担当します。
DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-ZENTSUJI-03-001-SHARED-01.translation: Today please walk around the field ridges and check the water. I will be responsible for operating the sluice gates.

DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-ZENTSUJI-03-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-ZENTSUJI-03-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 入口から二枚目の田んぼだけ、水が浅く見えます。水門を開ければよいのでしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-ZENTSUJI-03-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 二枚目の田んぼが浅いと伝え、水門操作で対応すべきか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-ZENTSUJI-03-001-SHARED-02.translation: Only the second rice field from the entrance looks shallow. Should I open the sluice gate?
DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-ZENTSUJI-03-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that the second rice field looks shallow and ask whether operating the sluice gate is the appropriate response.

DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-ZENTSUJI-03-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-ZENTSUJI-03-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 今は開けないでください。隣の区画と順番を調整しています。見えている目盛りはどの位置ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-ZENTSUJI-03-001-SHARED-03.translation: Please do not open it now. We are coordinating the order with the adjacent sections. What position does the visible gauge show?

DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-ZENTSUJI-03-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-ZENTSUJI-03-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 白い目盛りの一番下より少し上です。昨日と比べた記録は持っていません。
DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-ZENTSUJI-03-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 白い目盛り最下段より少し上だと答え、前日記録はないと明らかにする。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-ZENTSUJI-03-001-SHARED-04.translation: It is slightly above the lowest white mark. I do not have a record to compare with yesterday.
DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-ZENTSUJI-03-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Answer in Japanese that it is slightly above the lowest white mark and clarify that you have no record from the previous day.

DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-ZENTSUJI-03-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-ZENTSUJI-03-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: その位置を現在の記録に残しましょう。水門の操作とは別に、畦から水が漏れていないか、足元の安全な範囲で見てください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-ZENTSUJI-03-001-SHARED-05.translation: Let us record that position as the current reading. Separately from operating the gate, please check for leaks through the ridge within an area where your footing is safe.

DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-ZENTSUJI-03-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-ZENTSUJI-03-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 奥の斜面は滑りそうです。そこへ下りず、手前から見える範囲だけ確認してもよいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-ZENTSUJI-03-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 奥の斜面へ下りず手前から見える範囲だけを確認したいと申し出る。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-ZENTSUJI-03-001-SHARED-06.translation: The slope further in looks slippery. May I avoid going down there and check only what I can see from this side?
DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-ZENTSUJI-03-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you would like to check only what is visible from the near side without going down the slope.

DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-ZENTSUJI-03-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-ZENTSUJI-03-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 無理に下りなくて構いません。見えない場所は私が確認します。水が流れ出ている場所を見つけたら、位置を教えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-ZENTSUJI-03-001-SHARED-07.translation: You do not have to force yourself to go down. I will check places you cannot see. If you find water flowing out, please tell me its location.

DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-ZENTSUJI-03-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-ZENTSUJI-03-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 手前の角に細い流れがあります。目印の杭から二歩ほど左です。自分で土を詰める作業も控えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-ZENTSUJI-03-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 杭の左二歩の流れを報告し、自分で補修することは控えると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-ZENTSUJI-03-001-SHARED-08.translation: There is a thin stream at the near corner, about two steps left of the marker stake. I will also refrain from packing soil into it myself.
DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-ZENTSUJI-03-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Report in Japanese a flow two steps left of the stake and say that you will not repair it yourself.

DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-ZENTSUJI-03-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-ZENTSUJI-03-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 場所が分かりました。補修が必要か私が見ます。それまでは、他の区画の目盛りを同じ記録用紙に書いてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-ZENTSUJI-03-001-SHARED-09.translation: I understand the location. I will inspect whether repairs are necessary. Meanwhile, please record the other sections' gauge readings on the same sheet.

DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-ZENTSUJI-03-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-ZENTSUJI-03-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 二枚目の水位と流れの位置を記入して、残りの区画も見ます。水門や畦には手を加えません。
DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-ZENTSUJI-03-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 水位と位置を記録して巡回を続けるが水門や畦は変更しないと確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-ZENTSUJI-03-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will record the second field's water level and the stream's location, then check the remaining sections. I will not alter the sluice gates or ridges.
DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-ZENTSUJI-03-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Confirm in Japanese that you will record the water level and location and continue the rounds without changing the gates or ridges.

DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-ZENTSUJI-03-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-ZENTSUJI-03-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: その進め方でお願いします。私も手前の角へ向かいます。巡回、よろしくお願いします。
DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-ZENTSUJI-03-001-SHARED-11.translation: Please proceed that way. I will head for the near corner too. Thank you for making the rounds.

DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-ZENTSUJI-04-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-ZENTSUJI-04-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 生活についてのご相談を伺います。今日はどのようなことでお困りですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-ZENTSUJI-04-001-SHARED-01.translation: I can help with questions about daily life. What are you having trouble with today?

DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-ZENTSUJI-04-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-ZENTSUJI-04-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 子どもの学校から紙をもらいました。全部に申し込まないといけないのか分からず、まだ返していません。
DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-ZENTSUJI-04-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 学校の紙が全部必須の申し込みなのか分からず未返却だと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-ZENTSUJI-04-001-SHARED-02.translation: I received papers from my child's school. I do not know whether I have to apply for everything, so I have not returned them yet.
DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-ZENTSUJI-04-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you have not returned school papers because you are unsure whether all the applications are compulsory.

DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-ZENTSUJI-04-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-ZENTSUJI-04-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 紙を一緒に読みましょう。学校からの通知ですね。特に分かりにくい欄を指していただけますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-ZENTSUJI-04-001-SHARED-03.translation: Let us read them together. They are notices from school, then. Could you point to the part that is particularly unclear?

DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-ZENTSUJI-04-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-ZENTSUJI-04-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: この『参加を希望する方のみ』という所です。仕事で行けないので、断る理由を書く必要がありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-ZENTSUJI-04-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 参加希望者のみという欄を示し、行けない場合に理由記入が必要か聞く。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-ZENTSUJI-04-001-SHARED-04.translation: This part saying “Only those who wish to participate.” I cannot go because of work; do I need to write a reason for declining?
DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-ZENTSUJI-04-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Point to “Only those who wish to participate” and ask in Japanese whether you need to state a reason if you cannot go.

DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-ZENTSUJI-04-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-ZENTSUJI-04-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: この文は、参加したい方が記入するという意味です。ただ、返却が必要かは別の欄も確認しましょう。下に全員提出と書かれた用紙がありますね。
DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-ZENTSUJI-04-001-SHARED-05.translation: This sentence means people who want to participate should complete it. However, let us check the other sections separately to see whether it needs returning. There is a form below saying everyone must submit it.

DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-ZENTSUJI-04-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-ZENTSUJI-04-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 下の用紙も同じ申し込みだと思っていました。これは緊急連絡先を確認するための紙ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-ZENTSUJI-04-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 下の用紙も申し込みだと思っていたと述べ、緊急連絡先確認か質問する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-ZENTSUJI-04-001-SHARED-06.translation: I thought the lower form was the same application too. Is this a form for confirming emergency contact details?
DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-ZENTSUJI-04-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you thought the lower form was also an application, and ask whether it is for confirming emergency contacts.

DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-ZENTSUJI-04-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-ZENTSUJI-04-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: そのように書かれています。こちらには連絡先と、変更があるかどうかを記入する欄があります。学校に確認したい点は残っていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-ZENTSUJI-04-001-SHARED-07.translation: That is what it says. There are fields for contact details and whether anything has changed. Is there anything else you want to check with the school?

DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-ZENTSUJI-04-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-ZENTSUJI-04-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 父親の電話番号が変わったので、新しい番号を書きます。提出日を過ぎた場合の返し方は学校に聞きたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-ZENTSUJI-04-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 父親の新番号を記入し、提出日後の返却方法を学校へ確認したいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-ZENTSUJI-04-001-SHARED-08.translation: The father's phone number has changed, so I will write the new number. I want to ask the school how to return it if the submission date has passed.
DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-ZENTSUJI-04-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you will enter the father's new number and want to check with the school how to return it after the submission date.

DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-ZENTSUJI-04-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-ZENTSUJI-04-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 返し方は学校の担当者へ確認するのが確実です。問い合わせのときは、『提出が遅れた緊急連絡先の用紙をどう返せばよいですか』と伝えられます。
DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-ZENTSUJI-04-001-SHARED-09.translation: The surest way is to check with the responsible staff at school. You can ask, “How should I return an emergency-contact form whose submission is late?”

DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-ZENTSUJI-04-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-ZENTSUJI-04-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: その言い方をメモしました。連絡先の紙を記入してから、学校へ返却方法を問い合わせます。
DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-ZENTSUJI-04-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 教わった問い合わせ表現をメモし、連絡先記入後に学校へ返し方を聞くと述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-ZENTSUJI-04-001-SHARED-10.translation: I have noted that wording. I will fill in the contact-information form and then ask the school how to return it.
DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-ZENTSUJI-04-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you noted the suggested inquiry wording and will ask the school how to return the form after filling in the contacts.

DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-ZENTSUJI-04-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-ZENTSUJI-04-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 必要な用紙を区別できましたね。通知がまた分かりにくいときはご相談ください。今日はお疲れさまでした。
DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-ZENTSUJI-04-001-SHARED-11.translation: You have distinguished the required forms now. Please consult us again if another notice is unclear. Thank you for coming today.

DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-ZENTSUJI-05-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-ZENTSUJI-05-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 洗濯機をご検討ですね。設置場所の寸法はお分かりでしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-ZENTSUJI-05-001-SHARED-01.translation: You are considering a washing machine. Do you know the dimensions of the installation space?

DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-ZENTSUJI-05-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-ZENTSUJI-05-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 防水パンの内側は測ってきました。幅六十センチなら、こちらの機種は置けますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-ZENTSUJI-05-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 防水パン内側の幅六十センチを示し、候補機種が設置できるか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-ZENTSUJI-05-001-SHARED-02.translation: I measured the inside of the drain pan. If it is sixty centimeters wide, can this model be installed there?
DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-ZENTSUJI-05-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Give the drain pan's inside width of sixty centimeters and ask in Japanese whether the candidate model can be installed.

DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-ZENTSUJI-05-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-ZENTSUJI-05-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 本体の幅だけでなく、必要な余裕や蛇口の位置も確認します。ご自宅までの搬入経路は測りましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-ZENTSUJI-05-001-SHARED-03.translation: We need to check the required clearance and faucet position as well as the machine's own width. Have you measured the delivery route into your home?

DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-ZENTSUJI-05-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-ZENTSUJI-05-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 玄関は測っていません。廊下の曲がり角も狭いので、置けても運べないかもしれませんね。
DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-ZENTSUJI-05-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 玄関を測っておらず廊下の角も狭いため運搬できない可能性を述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-ZENTSUJI-05-001-SHARED-04.translation: I have not measured the entrance. The hallway corner is narrow too, so even if it fits in place, it might not be possible to bring it in.
DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-ZENTSUJI-05-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that the entrance is unmeasured and the hallway corner is narrow, so delivery might be impossible.

DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-ZENTSUJI-05-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-ZENTSUJI-05-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: そうですね。この機種の寸法図をお渡しできます。設置場所に加え、入口や曲がり角、階段があればその幅も確認してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-ZENTSUJI-05-001-SHARED-05.translation: That is right. We can give you this model's dimension drawing. Besides the installation space, please check the entrance, corners, and the width of any stairs.

DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-ZENTSUJI-05-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-ZENTSUJI-05-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 三階でエレベーターがありません。重さだけで選ばず、搬入条件を相談する必要がありそうです。
DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-ZENTSUJI-05-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: エレベーターのない三階への搬入について相談が必要だと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-ZENTSUJI-05-001-SHARED-06.translation: It is on the third floor without an elevator. It seems I need to discuss delivery conditions rather than choose based on weight alone.
DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-ZENTSUJI-05-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Explain in Japanese that delivery to a third floor without an elevator needs to be discussed.

DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-ZENTSUJI-05-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-ZENTSUJI-05-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 階段での搬入について配送担当に条件を確認しましょう。現場の状況によって追加の確認が必要で、店頭の寸法だけでは判断できません。
DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-ZENTSUJI-05-001-SHARED-07.translation: Let us check the conditions for carrying it up stairs with the delivery staff. The site conditions may require further checks, and dimensions at the store alone are not enough to decide.

DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-ZENTSUJI-05-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-ZENTSUJI-05-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 今日は購入を決めず、入口と階段の幅を測り直します。寸法図に、測る場所を書き込んでもらえますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-ZENTSUJI-05-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 当日は決めず入口と階段を測り直すと伝え、図へ確認箇所を記すよう頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-ZENTSUJI-05-001-SHARED-08.translation: I will not decide to buy today; I will remeasure the entrance and stair widths. Could you mark on the drawing which places I should measure?
DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-ZENTSUJI-05-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you will not decide today and will remeasure the entrance and stairs, and ask the staff to mark what to check on the drawing.

DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-ZENTSUJI-05-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-ZENTSUJI-05-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 図の余白へ確認する箇所を記します。型番もここにありますので、次に来られたときに照合できます。
DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-ZENTSUJI-05-001-SHARED-09.translation: I will note the places to check in the drawing's margin. The model number is here too, so we can match it when you next visit.

DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-ZENTSUJI-05-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-ZENTSUJI-05-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: この型番と測定メモを持って、もう一度相談します。配送条件が分かってから注文したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-ZENTSUJI-05-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 型番と測定メモを持参し、配送条件が確認できてから注文すると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-ZENTSUJI-05-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will bring this model number and my measurement notes to consult you again. I would like to order after the delivery conditions are clear.
DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-ZENTSUJI-05-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you will bring the model number and measurement notes and order after confirming delivery conditions.

DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-ZENTSUJI-05-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-ZENTSUJI-05-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: その際に配送担当にもつなぎます。寸法図をお持ちください。ご来店ありがとうございました。
DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-ZENTSUJI-05-001-SHARED-11.translation: We will connect you with the delivery staff then too. Please take the dimension drawing. Thank you for visiting.

DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-ZENTSUJI-06-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-ZENTSUJI-06-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 二〇五号室は退室確認済みです。清掃を始めてください。忘れ物があれば、捨てずに私へ知らせてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-ZENTSUJI-06-001-SHARED-01.translation: Room 205 has been confirmed vacated. Please begin cleaning. If you find anything left behind, tell me rather than throw it away.

DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-ZENTSUJI-06-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-ZENTSUJI-06-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 机の引き出しに腕時計があります。お客様の忘れ物か、備品か判断できません。
DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-ZENTSUJI-06-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 引き出しの腕時計が忘れ物か備品か不明だと報告する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-ZENTSUJI-06-001-SHARED-02.translation: There is a wristwatch in the desk drawer. I cannot tell whether it is a guest's lost item or room equipment.
DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-ZENTSUJI-06-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Report in Japanese that you do not know whether the wristwatch in the drawer is lost property or room equipment.

DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-ZENTSUJI-06-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-ZENTSUJI-06-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 備品の一覧に腕時計はありません。見つかった場所を残して、忘れ物として担当に引き継ぎます。今はどこに置いてありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-ZENTSUJI-06-001-SHARED-03.translation: There is no wristwatch on the equipment list. We will record where it was found and hand it over as lost property. Where is it now?

DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-ZENTSUJI-06-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-ZENTSUJI-06-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 引き出しを開けた状態で、時計は元の位置にあります。まだ身に着けたり操作したりしていません。
DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-ZENTSUJI-06-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 時計を元の位置に置いたままで装着も操作もしていないと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-ZENTSUJI-06-001-SHARED-04.translation: The drawer is open, and the watch is still in its original position. I have not worn it or operated it.
DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-ZENTSUJI-06-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain in Japanese that the watch remains where you found it and you have neither worn nor operated it.

DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-ZENTSUJI-06-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-ZENTSUJI-06-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: そのまま触らず待ってください。私が袋と記録用紙を持って行きます。見つけた部屋と場所、時間を記入しましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-ZENTSUJI-06-001-SHARED-05.translation: Please wait without touching it. I will bring a bag and record sheet. Let us enter the room, location, and time where you found it.

DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-ZENTSUJI-06-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-ZENTSUJI-06-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 二〇五号室の机の上段、発見は十時二十分です。時計の名前や持ち主は分からないので、外見だけ書きます。
DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-ZENTSUJI-06-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 部屋番号、上段の引き出し、十時二十分を示し、外見のみ記載すると答える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-ZENTSUJI-06-001-SHARED-06.translation: The top desk drawer in room 205, found at 10:20. I do not know the watch's name or owner, so I will describe only its appearance.
DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-ZENTSUJI-06-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Give room 205, the upper drawer, and 10:20 in Japanese, and say that you will record only its appearance.

DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-ZENTSUJI-06-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-ZENTSUJI-06-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: はい、確認したことだけ書いてください。引き継ぎ後は、その引き出しも含めて清掃を再開できます。ほかに未確認の箇所はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-ZENTSUJI-06-001-SHARED-07.translation: Yes, write only what you have confirmed. After the handover, you may resume cleaning, including that drawer. Are there any other areas you have not checked?

DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-ZENTSUJI-06-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-ZENTSUJI-06-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: ベッドの下はまだ見ていません。時計の引き継ぎが終わったら、そこも確認してから掃除します。
DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-ZENTSUJI-06-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: ベッドの下は未確認なので引き継ぎ後に確認して掃除すると述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-ZENTSUJI-06-001-SHARED-08.translation: I have not checked under the bed yet. Once the watch handover is complete, I will check there before cleaning it too.
DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-ZENTSUJI-06-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that under the bed is unchecked and you will inspect and clean it after the handover.

DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-ZENTSUJI-06-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-ZENTSUJI-06-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: お願いします。袋に入れた品は清掃用の棚へ置かず、私が忘れ物担当へ渡します。記録用紙の内容を一緒に確認しましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-ZENTSUJI-06-001-SHARED-09.translation: Please do. Do not leave the bagged item on the cleaning shelf; I will give it to the lost-property staff. Let us check the record sheet together.

DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-ZENTSUJI-06-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-ZENTSUJI-06-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 部屋、引き出し、時刻を照合しました。担当へ渡してもらい、私は残りの確認と清掃を進めます。
DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-ZENTSUJI-06-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 記録の部屋と場所と時刻を照合し、忘れ物は担当へ任せ清掃を続けると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-ZENTSUJI-06-001-SHARED-10.translation: I have verified the room, drawer, and time. I will leave handing it to the responsible staff to you and continue the remaining checks and cleaning.
DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-ZENTSUJI-06-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you verified the recorded room, place, and time, will leave the lost item to the responsible staff, and will continue cleaning.

DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-ZENTSUJI-06-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-ZENTSUJI-06-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: これで引き継げます。早めの報告が助かりました。続きの清掃もよろしくお願いします。
DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-ZENTSUJI-06-001-SHARED-11.translation: We can hand it over with this. Your prompt report was helpful. Please continue with the rest of the cleaning.

DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-ZENTSUJI-07-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-ZENTSUJI-07-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: ケーブルをお探しですか。接続する機器と用途を教えていただけますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-ZENTSUJI-07-001-SHARED-01.translation: Are you looking for a cable? Could you tell me the devices you will connect and what you want to do?

DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-ZENTSUJI-07-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-ZENTSUJI-07-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 携帯の写真をパソコンへ移したいです。このケーブルで、充電と写真の転送の両方ができますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-ZENTSUJI-07-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 携帯の写真をパソコンへ移すため充電と転送の両機能があるか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-ZENTSUJI-07-001-SHARED-02.translation: I want to move photos from my phone to a computer. Can this cable both charge and transfer photos?
DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-ZENTSUJI-07-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask in Japanese whether the cable supports both charging and transferring your phone's photos to a computer.

DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-ZENTSUJI-07-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-ZENTSUJI-07-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: こちらの袋には『充電専用』と書かれています。写真の転送が目的なら、データ通信に対応する表示も確認する必要があります。
DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-ZENTSUJI-07-001-SHARED-03.translation: This package says “Charging only.” If your purpose is transferring photos, you also need to check for an indication that it supports data transfer.

DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-ZENTSUJI-07-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-ZENTSUJI-07-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 先の形が合えば使えると思っていました。転送にも使えるものは、この棚にありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-ZENTSUJI-07-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 形が合えば使えると思っていたと述べ、転送対応品の場所を聞く。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-ZENTSUJI-07-001-SHARED-04.translation: I thought it would work as long as the ends fitted. Is there a cable on this shelf that also supports transfers?
DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-ZENTSUJI-07-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you thought matching connector shapes were enough, and ask where transfer-compatible products are.

DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-ZENTSUJI-07-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-ZENTSUJI-07-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 棚の右側に『データ通信対応』と書かれた品があります。ただ、端子の種類も両側で確認してください。パソコン側はどの形ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-ZENTSUJI-07-001-SHARED-05.translation: On the right of the shelf there are products labeled “Supports data transfer.” However, please check the connector type at both ends too. What shape is the computer end?

DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-ZENTSUJI-07-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-ZENTSUJI-07-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: パソコン側は長方形で、携帯側は両面を同じ向きに挿せる小さい形です。名前が分からないので、端子の写真を見てもらえますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-ZENTSUJI-07-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 二つの端子の形を言葉で示し、名称不明なので写真の確認を頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-ZENTSUJI-07-001-SHARED-06.translation: The computer end is rectangular, and the phone end is a small shape that can be plugged in either way up. I do not know their names; could you look at photos of the ports?
DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-ZENTSUJI-07-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Describe both connector shapes in Japanese and ask the staff to check photos because you do not know the names.

DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-ZENTSUJI-07-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-ZENTSUJI-07-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 写真だけで断定しにくい場合もありますが、形を比べる手がかりにはできます。こちらの端子図と照合しましょう。この品の値札は三百三十円です。
DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-ZENTSUJI-07-001-SHARED-07.translation: Photos alone may not always be conclusive, but they can help us compare shapes. Let us match them with this connector diagram. This item's price label says three hundred thirty yen.

DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-ZENTSUJI-07-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-ZENTSUJI-07-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: どの商品も百十円だと思っていました。三百三十円でもよいですが、対応する機器を確認してから買います。
DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-ZENTSUJI-07-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 百十円一律だと思ったが三百三十円でもよく、機器との対応を確かめてから買うと答える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-ZENTSUJI-07-001-SHARED-08.translation: I thought everything was one hundred ten yen. Three hundred thirty yen is fine too, but I will buy it after checking device compatibility.
DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-ZENTSUJI-07-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you thought all items were one hundred ten yen, but three hundred thirty is acceptable and you will check compatibility before buying.

DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-ZENTSUJI-07-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-ZENTSUJI-07-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 機器の説明書の端子名を確認していただくと確実です。今日は品番と袋の表示を控えておかれますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-ZENTSUJI-07-001-SHARED-09.translation: Checking the connector names in the devices' instructions will be more certain. Would you like to note the product number and package wording today?

DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-ZENTSUJI-07-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-ZENTSUJI-07-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 品番とデータ通信対応の表示を控えます。家で両方の端子名を確かめてから選びます。
DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-ZENTSUJI-07-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 品番と通信対応表示を控え、自宅で両機器の端子名を調べると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-ZENTSUJI-07-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will note the product number and the data-transfer-compatible label. I will choose after checking both devices' connector names at home.
DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-ZENTSUJI-07-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you will note the product number and data-transfer indication and check both connector names at home.

DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-ZENTSUJI-07-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-ZENTSUJI-07-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 気になる品があれば、次回またお尋ねください。確認のお手伝いをします。ご来店ありがとうございました。
DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-ZENTSUJI-07-001-SHARED-11.translation: Please ask again next time if there is a product you are interested in. We will help you check it. Thank you for visiting.

DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-ZENTSUJI-08-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-ZENTSUJI-08-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: お振り込みの操作でお困りですね。どの画面まで進まれましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-ZENTSUJI-08-001-SHARED-01.translation: You are having trouble operating a bank transfer. Which screen have you reached?

DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-ZENTSUJI-08-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-ZENTSUJI-08-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 暗証番号を入れる所で止まっています。番号をお伝えするので、代わりに押してもらえませんか。
DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-ZENTSUJI-08-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 暗証番号入力で止まったと伝え、職員へ代理操作を頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-ZENTSUJI-08-001-SHARED-02.translation: I am stopped at entering my PIN. I will tell you the number; could you press the buttons for me?
DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-ZENTSUJI-08-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you are stopped at PIN entry and ask the staff to operate it for you.

DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-ZENTSUJI-08-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-ZENTSUJI-08-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 暗証番号は私にも伝えないでください。番号を見ずに、画面の説明をすることはできます。ご自身で入力をお願いします。
DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-ZENTSUJI-08-001-SHARED-03.translation: Please do not tell your PIN even to me. I can explain the screen without seeing the number. Please enter it yourself.

DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-ZENTSUJI-08-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-ZENTSUJI-08-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 分かりました。番号は言わずに自分で入れます。その後、振込先を確認する画面まで教えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-ZENTSUJI-08-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 番号を伝えず自分で入力し、その後の振込先確認まで案内を求める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-ZENTSUJI-08-001-SHARED-04.translation: Understood. I will enter it myself without saying the number. Please then guide me as far as the recipient-confirmation screen.
DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-ZENTSUJI-08-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you will enter the number yourself without sharing it and ask for guidance to checking the recipient afterwards.

DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-ZENTSUJI-08-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-ZENTSUJI-08-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 入力が終わったら、振込先の銀行名と支店名を選ぶ案内が出ます。請求書と照らして進め、確認画面で内容を見直してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-ZENTSUJI-08-001-SHARED-05.translation: After entry, guidance will appear for selecting the recipient bank and branch. Compare it with the invoice as you proceed, then review the details on the confirmation screen.

DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-ZENTSUJI-08-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-ZENTSUJI-08-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 確認画面に出た名義が、請求書の会社名と少し違います。このまま確定してよいのでしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-ZENTSUJI-08-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 画面の名義と請求書の会社名の違いを報告し、確定してよいか質問する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-ZENTSUJI-08-001-SHARED-06.translation: The account name shown on the confirmation screen is slightly different from the company name on the invoice. Is it all right to confirm it as it is?
DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-ZENTSUJI-08-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Report in Japanese that the screen's account name differs from the invoicing company's name and ask whether to confirm.

DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-ZENTSUJI-08-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-ZENTSUJI-08-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 違いの理由は、こちらでは今の情報だけで判断できません。確定せず、請求元へ登録された振込先を確認しましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-ZENTSUJI-08-001-SHARED-07.translation: We cannot determine the reason for that difference from the information we have now. Do not confirm it; let us check the registered transfer destination with the issuer of the invoice.

DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-ZENTSUJI-08-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-ZENTSUJI-08-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: それなら今は中止します。問い合わせるときに、支店名と口座番号のほかに何を聞けばよいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-ZENTSUJI-08-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 今は中止すると決め、支店と番号以外に問い合わせる情報を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-ZENTSUJI-08-001-SHARED-08.translation: Then I will cancel for now. When asking them, what should I check besides the branch name and account number?
DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-ZENTSUJI-08-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Decide in Japanese to cancel for now and ask what information to request besides the branch and account number.

DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-ZENTSUJI-08-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-ZENTSUJI-08-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 口座名義の正確な表記も尋ねてください。請求書にない変更案内を受けた場合は、以前から確認できている連絡先などで慎重に照合してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-ZENTSUJI-08-001-SHARED-09.translation: Please also ask for the exact spelling of the account holder's name. If you receive change instructions not on the invoice, carefully compare them using a contact you have already verified, for example.

DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-ZENTSUJI-08-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-ZENTSUJI-08-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 口座名義まで確かめてから、改めて操作します。いまの入力は中止し、カードを受け取って帰ります。
DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-ZENTSUJI-08-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 名義を確認してから再操作し、現在の入力を中止してカードを受け取ると述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-ZENTSUJI-08-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will operate it again after confirming the account name too. I will cancel the current entry, take my card, and leave.
DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-ZENTSUJI-08-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you will confirm the account name before trying again, cancel the current entry, and collect your card.

DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-ZENTSUJI-08-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-ZENTSUJI-08-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 中止後にカードのお取り忘れがないか確認してください。分からない操作はまたご相談ください。お気をつけてお帰りください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-ZENTSUJI-08-001-SHARED-11.translation: After canceling, please check that you have not left your card behind. Ask us again about any operation you do not understand. Take care on your way home.

DLG-SC-KNG-ATSUGI-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-KNG-ATSUGI-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 測定結果を教えてください。
DLG-SC-KNG-ATSUGI-001-SHARED-01.translation: Please tell me the measurement results.

DLG-SC-KNG-ATSUGI-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-KNG-ATSUGI-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 一個は合いましたが、箱全体を合格と書いてよいですか。
DLG-SC-KNG-ATSUGI-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 一個測定の全数扱いを相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-KNG-ATSUGI-001-SHARED-02.translation: One item matched, but may I mark the whole box as passed?
DLG-SC-KNG-ATSUGI-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask in Japanese whether measuring one item can be treated as checking all items.

DLG-SC-KNG-ATSUGI-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-KNG-ATSUGI-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 検査範囲を担当と確認します。
DLG-SC-KNG-ATSUGI-001-SHARED-03.translation: We will confirm the inspection scope with the responsible staff.

DLG-SC-KNG-ATSUGI-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-KNG-ATSUGI-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 測ったのは最初の一個だけです。全数とは書きません。
DLG-SC-KNG-ATSUGI-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 実測範囲を示す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-KNG-ATSUGI-001-SHARED-04.translation: I measured only the first item. I will not write that every item was checked.
DLG-SC-KNG-ATSUGI-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: State the actual measurement scope in Japanese.

DLG-SC-KNG-ATSUGI-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-KNG-ATSUGI-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 対象の箱番号をお願いします。
DLG-SC-KNG-ATSUGI-001-SHARED-05.translation: Please give me the relevant box number.

DLG-SC-KNG-ATSUGI-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-KNG-ATSUGI-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 八番です。隣の箱の結果とは分けます。
DLG-SC-KNG-ATSUGI-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 箱番号を特定する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-KNG-ATSUGI-001-SHARED-06.translation: It is number eight. I will keep its results separate from the adjacent box's results.
DLG-SC-KNG-ATSUGI-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Identify the box number in Japanese.

DLG-SC-KNG-ATSUGI-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-KNG-ATSUGI-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 次の測定は指示を待ってください。
DLG-SC-KNG-ATSUGI-001-SHARED-07.translation: Please wait for instructions before the next measurement.

DLG-SC-KNG-ATSUGI-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-KNG-ATSUGI-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 機械の設定を変えず、測定した一個も識別して残します。
DLG-SC-KNG-ATSUGI-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 設定不変で測定品を識別する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-KNG-ATSUGI-001-SHARED-08.translation: I will leave the machine settings unchanged and identify and retain the one item I measured too.
DLG-SC-KNG-ATSUGI-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you will keep the settings unchanged and identify the measured item.

DLG-SC-KNG-ATSUGI-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-KNG-ATSUGI-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 記録には状態を区別してください。
DLG-SC-KNG-ATSUGI-001-SHARED-09.translation: Please distinguish the statuses in the record.

DLG-SC-KNG-ATSUGI-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-KNG-ATSUGI-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 一個測定済み、残り未確認として引き継ぎます。
DLG-SC-KNG-ATSUGI-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 未確認品を分けて記録する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-KNG-ATSUGI-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will hand it over as one item measured and the remaining items unconfirmed.
DLG-SC-KNG-ATSUGI-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you will record unchecked items separately.

DLG-SC-KNG-ATSUGI-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-KNG-ATSUGI-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: その範囲を担当へ確認します。箱全体の合格表示と出荷は待ってください。
DLG-SC-KNG-ATSUGI-001-SHARED-11.translation: We will confirm that scope with the responsible staff. Please wait before marking the whole box as passed or shipping it.

DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-ATSUGI-02-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-ATSUGI-02-001-SHARED-01.translation: Are you buying this as well?

DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-ATSUGI-02-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-ATSUGI-02-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: はい、買い忘れました。前の袋は会計済みです。
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-ATSUGI-02-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 追加と精算済みを分ける。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-ATSUGI-02-001-SHARED-02.translation: Yes, I forgot to buy it. The items in the earlier bag have already been paid for.
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-ATSUGI-02-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Distinguish the additional item from the paid items in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-ATSUGI-02-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-ATSUGI-02-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 追加品をこちらへお願いします。
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-ATSUGI-02-001-SHARED-03.translation: Please place the additional item here.

DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-ATSUGI-02-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-ATSUGI-02-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 卵一パックだけです。袋の中は再会計しないでください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-ATSUGI-02-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 追加一品の数量を示す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-ATSUGI-02-001-SHARED-04.translation: It is just one pack of eggs. Please do not charge again for the contents of the bag.
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-ATSUGI-02-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: State the quantity of the one additional item in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-ATSUGI-02-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-ATSUGI-02-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 購入済みの記録はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-ATSUGI-02-001-SHARED-05.translation: Do you have a record of the earlier purchase?

DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-ATSUGI-02-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-ATSUGI-02-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: このレシートです。追加と分けて示します。
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-ATSUGI-02-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 元レシートを提示する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-ATSUGI-02-001-SHARED-06.translation: Here is the receipt. I will show it separately from the additional item.
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-ATSUGI-02-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Present the original receipt in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-ATSUGI-02-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-ATSUGI-02-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 新しい袋も必要ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-ATSUGI-02-001-SHARED-07.translation: Do you need another bag too?

DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-ATSUGI-02-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-ATSUGI-02-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: いえ、卵が潰れないよう元の袋へ入れられますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-ATSUGI-02-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 袋追加不要と配置を相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-ATSUGI-02-001-SHARED-08.translation: No. Can you put the eggs in the original bag so that they will not get crushed?
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-ATSUGI-02-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you do not need another bag and discuss placement of the eggs.

DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-ATSUGI-02-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-ATSUGI-02-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 重い物は下で、卵を上へ入れます。
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-ATSUGI-02-001-SHARED-09.translation: I will put heavy items at the bottom and the eggs on top.

DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-ATSUGI-02-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-ATSUGI-02-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: お願いします。追加品の代金を払い、新しいレシートも残します。
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-ATSUGI-02-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 追加精算と記録を確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-ATSUGI-02-001-SHARED-10.translation: Please do. I will pay for the additional item and keep the new receipt too.
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-ATSUGI-02-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Confirm the additional payment and record in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-ATSUGI-02-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-ATSUGI-02-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 卵一パックだけ会計しました。二つのレシートと商品をお持ちください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-ATSUGI-02-001-SHARED-11.translation: I have charged only for one pack of eggs. Please take both receipts and your goods.

DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-ATSUGI-03-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-ATSUGI-03-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 麺の量はいかがしますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-ATSUGI-03-001-SHARED-01.translation: How much would you like in your noodle portion?

DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-ATSUGI-03-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-ATSUGI-03-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 最初は少なめで、足りなければ後で頼めますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-ATSUGI-03-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 少量後の追加方法を聞く。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-ATSUGI-03-001-SHARED-02.translation: Could I start with a smaller portion and order more later if it is not enough?
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-ATSUGI-03-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask in Japanese how to add more after starting with a small portion.

DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-ATSUGI-03-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-ATSUGI-03-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 追加麺の条件を確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-ATSUGI-03-001-SHARED-03.translation: I will check the conditions for extra noodles.

DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-ATSUGI-03-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-ATSUGI-03-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 初めから二人分を出す希望ではありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-ATSUGI-03-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 初回二人分でないと示す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-ATSUGI-03-001-SHARED-04.translation: I am not asking you to serve two people's portions from the start.
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-ATSUGI-03-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Clarify in Japanese that the initial order is not two portions.

DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-ATSUGI-03-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-ATSUGI-03-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: この場面では追加を別注文できます。
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-ATSUGI-03-001-SHARED-05.translation: Here, you can place a separate order for extra noodles.

DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-ATSUGI-03-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-ATSUGI-03-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: では最初は一杯の少量です。追加料金も教えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-ATSUGI-03-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 初回量と追加料金を確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-ATSUGI-03-001-SHARED-06.translation: Then I will start with one bowl with a small portion. Please also tell me the extra charge.
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-ATSUGI-03-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Confirm the initial portion and additional charge in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-ATSUGI-03-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-ATSUGI-03-001-SHARED-07.translation: The extra noodles cost one hundred yen.

DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-ATSUGI-03-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-ATSUGI-03-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 分かりました。今は追加を通さないでください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-ATSUGI-03-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 追加の先注文を止める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-ATSUGI-03-001-SHARED-08.translation: Understood. Please do not put through an order for extra noodles now.
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-ATSUGI-03-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Stop an advance order for extras in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-ATSUGI-03-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-ATSUGI-03-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 食べてから係に声を掛けてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-ATSUGI-03-001-SHARED-09.translation: Please speak to a staff member after you have eaten.

DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-ATSUGI-03-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-ATSUGI-03-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: はい。足りるかを見て、必要な時だけ注文します。
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-ATSUGI-03-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 必要時だけ注文すると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-ATSUGI-03-001-SHARED-10.translation: Yes. I will see whether it is enough and order only if necessary.
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-ATSUGI-03-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you will order only when needed.

DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-ATSUGI-03-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-ATSUGI-03-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 少量の一杯で受けます。追加麺は未注文として、声掛けをお待ちします。
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-ATSUGI-03-001-SHARED-11.translation: We will take the order as one bowl with a small portion. The extra noodles remain unordered, and we will wait for you to call us.
